summary: Migrated hisab backend from Supabase cloud to a self-hosted Supabase instance running on hermes_drive. Docker and containerd data roots were relocated to /mnt/hermes_drive/0_DATA to free the root disk from 97% usage. All Supabase services came up healthy except Kong, which hit a Docker port-binding race condition on 8000.
highlights: Relocated Docker + containerd data-root to hermes_drive, dropping root disk usage from 97% to ~65%
Deployed full self-hosted Supabase stack (13 images, 10/11 containers healthy) inside /mnt/hermes_drive/0_DATA/supabase/
Applied security overlay (docker-compose.hisab.yml): all ports bound to 127.0.0.1, all services on hisab-network, backend connects directly to supabase-db bypassing Kong/supavisor
Updated hisab backend docker-compose, db/pool.ts (ssl: false for internal network), .env, and CI/CD pipeline to target self-hosted Postgres
Created backup.sh, restore.sh, and migrate_from_cloud.sh utility scripts for the self-hosted Supabase data directory
